App concept
  1. Your craft. Her booking.

    Be the artist she books by name.

    When the PinkOut app launches, women in Riyadh book beauty with a person, not a salon: at home or at a PinkOut location. Follow one booking from her first tap to her review, and see what you get at every step.

    • At home or at PinkOut
    • Your own calendar
    • Paid in the app
    • Rated by her

    Scroll to follow her booking

  2. 01
    Step 1 of 7She opens Beauty

    She starts with what she needs.

    Makeup, hair, nails, lashes, henna or skincare. Your services sit in the categories she browses.

    What you get

    • List every service you offer
    • Set your own durations and prices
    • Show up in every category you work in

    The value for you

    • Found by service
    • Seen by a women-first audience
    • Your prices, your timings
  3. 02
    Step 2 of 7At home, or at PinkOut

    She chooses where.

    At home, she adds her address and only artists who cover her area appear. At PinkOut, she picks a location with a free station.

    What you get

    • Work at homes, at PinkOut locations, or both
    • Set your coverage area and travel charge
    • Use a partner station, no salon of your own needed

    The value for you

    • A station when you need one
    • Clients in your area
    • One calendar for both
  4. 03
    Step 3 of 7Artists, by name

    Your name, where she is looking.

    She compares individual artists who are free when she is: their work, prices and ratings. She chooses a person, not a team.

    What you get

    • Appear when you are free
    • Lead with your best looks
    • Stand out on ratings

    The value for you

    • People, not salons
    • Your work comes first
    • Ratings that build
  5. 04
    Step 4 of 7Your profile

    She sees your work.

    Portfolio, services, durations, prices, ratings and where you work: everything she needs to choose you.

    What you get

    • Build a portfolio of your looks
    • Link your Instagram
    • Show where and when you work

    The value for you

    • A portfolio that sells
    • Saved by clients
    • Your name as your brand
  6. 05
    Step 5 of 7Booked and paid

    One tap. Booked and paid.

    She picks the service, day and time, sees the full price with any travel charge and pays in the app. The booking lands in your calendar, or waits for you to accept.

    What you get

    • Accept requests, or confirm instantly
    • Time blocked, travel included
    • Paid through the app

    The value for you

    • No double bookings
    • Payment handled
    • Changes in one place
  7. 06
    Step 6 of 7On the day

    She follows you to the door.

    Reminders, chat and every status as it changes: confirmed, on the way, arrived, in progress. At PinkOut, she checks in and your station is ready.

    What you get

    • Message her before the visit
    • Update your status as you go
    • Address and prep details in hand

    The value for you

    • Clear updates both ways
    • Arrive on time
    • Station ready at PinkOut
  8. 07
    Step 7 of 7After the look

    Rated, and credited to Your name.

    You mark it complete, she rates you, and the review lands on your profile. The look carries your name, and she books you again.

    What you get

    • Reviews on your profile
    • Earnings and payouts in one view
    • First visits that become regulars

    The value for you

    • Reputation that grows
    • Earnings tracked
    • Repeat bookings
One booking, three views

One booking. Three views.

Clients book you, the person, not a salon. The same booking shows in her app, in yours and, at a PinkOut location, on the partner's schedule. Play it from request to review.

  • ClientShe chooses a person, not a team: your profile, portfolio, prices and ratings. She enters her address, and your coverage area, travel time and any travel charge are already counted.
  • ArtistHome and PinkOut bookings share one personal calendar, so nothing overlaps. You get the address and travel details the visit needs.
  • PartnerAt-home bookings don't use a PinkOut location. A partner that manages the artist can follow the booking, as agreed with her.

When plans change

  • CancelledThe artist's time, and any station, are released.
  • RescheduledBoth schedules move together when a station is booked.
  • DeclinedThe temporary hold is released and the client is told.
  • Late or no-showMarked on the booking, with its effect on payments and refunds.

FAQ

Good questions, clear answers.

What exactly is PinkOut?

A women-first lifestyle, creativity and entertainment destination coming soon to Riyadh, with seven experience zones and an app in development.

When and where does it open?

In Riyadh. The exact date and venue will be announced once confirmed.

What are the fees or commission?

Commercial terms are shared after you apply, in the deck for your partner type.

Are any partners confirmed?

No partnerships have been announced yet.

Do I need a license to apply?

Yes: a valid license or professional certificate, plus a portfolio or Instagram that shows your work.

When do bookings start?

When the PinkOut app launches. Beauty services are booked through the app, at the client's home or at a PinkOut location.

Can I work at the event?

The event is run with event partners. Beauty service partners work through the PinkOut app: at clients' homes, at PinkOut locations, or both.

Can salons apply, or only freelancers?

Both. The form asks whether you're applying as a freelance artist or as a salon or beauty business.
